description.value:
Requirements Your core is projecting your hardlight body

Effect Your hardlight body disappears, and your core falls harmlessly to the ground. You can select any number of items you were carrying or wearing to store in your core's virtual storage, up to its maximum capacity, with the remaining items landing harmlessly in your space. Your size becomes Tiny, you weigh 1 Bulk, and you can't act except to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Recall Knowledge], Project Hardlight Body, and use actions that require only your mind (as determined by the GM). Your senses still function when your body isn't projected.
